notes.title: Huge Input Update! Adds support for many more devices!
notes.notes: [p][b]Input System Overhaul:[/b][/p][p]-Added support for Direct Input devices, massively improving compatibility with transmitters, sim wheels, old joysticks, etc.[/p][p]-More robust calibration for throttle and steering, allowing for all sorts of different devices to perfectly calibrate input for the game, no need to even adjust trims or end points on your transmitters![/p][p]-Added ability to force a specific device when calibrating[/p][p]-Improved detection of inputs when rebinding[/p][p]-Improved and expanded throttle and steering setup wizard to better handle calibration and correctly setting up a variety of different devices[/p][p]-Improved individual quick rebinding for throttle and steering[/p][p]-Detection/ignoring for noisy/bad inputs when rebinding[/p][p]-Fixed issues with input detection when multiple devices were connected[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/b9ec155a35e7fd9baacd81a8e986e28c286b60e2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Full input rebinding support:[/b][/p][p]-Added ability to rebind every key in the game, both for controller and keyboard independently, and with an extra empty slot for joysticks (transmitters, sim wheels, etc.)[/p][p]-All new input settings menu with improved controller navigation and access to all new input features[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/8e62de52fbcbe3d0a2a82a47a0b36ed1bc945992.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Physics patch fix + a couple bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Physics Improvements:[/b]
-Fixed unwanted roll-over behavior introduced in the last update
-Tweaked HB24 asphalt handling to be less flippy

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed bad collision on VR-08 campaign track
-Fixed being unable to delete empty track

notes.title: Huge physics improvement update and more!
notes.notes: [p]Physics Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Significant improvements have been made to tire collision systems, drastically improving handling, stability, and friction on bumpy surfaces where the vehicles used to skip along the ground before[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/bc0e6785f8ea560a150a143c06dd92927dc3922a.gif"][/img][/p][p]New Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added a fancy new news menu to keep up with game updates[/p][/*][*][p]Online track selection now remembers last used category[/p][/*][*][p]Created tracks can now be copied, copied tracks can be uploaded again as long as they are edited first and given a new name[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/8cedcc5e62e3c52cc75356b60c29934237538255.png"][/img][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiplying tire forces when objects perfectly overlap each other[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed object holograms in editor occasionally becoming invisible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect error text in track editor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed campaign tracks showing up in recently played list online[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Quick patch fix
notes.notes: Quick patch fix for new HB24 bodies causing replays to break. Campaign unlock bodies will no longer cause problems!

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.notes:
[p]New Features:
Space bar now works as an additional reset button
Rewind feature is now much faster
[/p][p]Bug Fixes:
Fixed occasional missing skidmark bug
Fixed pause menu and respawn breaking rewind

notes.title: Hot Fix Update
notes.notes:
Hot Fixes:
Fixed streak appearing across screen when resetting sometimes
Fixed skid marks moving when changing reset positions
Fixed tires ballooning even when detached from vehicle
Fixed steering axis invert and steering sensitivity not working together
Fixed hangar venue having an invisible floor collider above the max depth
Fixed broken throttle invert setting

notes.title: Transmitter compatibility updates, new features, and some QOL changes!
notes.notes: [p]New Features:[/p][list][*][p]New feature profiles were added to the track creator[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/b078bd6f95950f923410b39469ea8adf49d7e793.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added Inverse axis centers option to control settings, this should fix issues with various transmitters/adapters that are stuck at 1 after setup. Setup wizard will automatically detects this and sets it up as well[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/a0ba0d3c222ce095e055b3193c4395ae5cc23dd2.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added adjustable drivers stand camera height[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/36cce8b0725d74b2234785153ca3cf27e31d8b1d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added higher speed adjustment for follow cam for a super responsive feeling camera[/p][/*][*][p]Added new blank livery options for all vehicles for an easy blank slate to get started with on custom liveries[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/0f1890de3546e47ceadf3af58f46f0bac0ef8cb1.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added add to favorites button to track rating menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to speed up campaign trophy animations by clicking/pressing submit button[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed being able to exit campaign menu before rewards given[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera being able to invert in paint booth[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed w and s zooming camera in paint booth, wasd can now properly be used for fine adjustments of decals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed track edges disappearing when exiting terrain editor sometimes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skid marks trailing across map after playing for long enough and resetting[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update #2!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][b]UI and Navigation Improvements:[/b][/p][p]-Enter track code box highlights when selected[/p][p]-Fixed leaderboard navigation bug causing controller to lose focus, improved load more behavior[/p][p]-Fixed scrolling list with mouse wheel zooming camera in and out[/p][p]-Back button on controller will now exit drop down menus rather than going back[/p][p]-Improved meaning of point to point/circuit option in track editor[/p][p]-Improved contrast on path editor screen[/p][p]-Fix for weird mouse interaction with drop down menus[/p][p]-Fixed not being able to change settings correctly with controller in options menu[/p][p]-Added ability to exit pause menu with back button[/p][p]-Added button to reset remapped controls back to default[/p][p]-Added share track button to rate menu when leaving a track[/p][p]-Pressing left from track select now auto selects the play button[/p][p]-Pressing left or right on any leaderboard entry will select play/back[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Fix for potential doubled steering inputs from keyboard+controller[/p][p]-Fixed exiting game while resetting to track causing physics to be permanently paused[/p][p]-Fixed mouse cursor getting locked out if you switched to mouse during a load transition[/p][p]-Removed joystick (non-standard controller) input from ui so mouse doesnt get locked out when using a joystick (like an rc transmitter)[/p][p]-Fixed game sounds playing while paused if you changed options[/p][p]-Fixed black bars showing for some people on scrolling menus[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][p]-Added "My Tracks" and "Developer Tracks" options to online track select[/p][p]-Added blob shadow under cars when real-time shadows are disabled[/p][p]-Added ability to change selected vehicle from pause menu while racing[/p][p]-Added ability to earn coins for completing laps[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Demo update just released!
-Fixed bug with timer sometimes not starting[/p][p]
-Tweaked track width tracking to not allow cutting on some tracks[/p][p]
-Fixed leaderboards showing wrong numbers when loading more[/p][p]
-Tweaked track edge friction so its not so punishing[/p][p]
-Fixed monitor hz showing decimals[/p][p]
-Tweaked low speed vehicle physics to allow slightly tighter turns (still needs more work but i didnt want to make huge changes that could mess up the leaderboards)

-Few other minor UI and bug fixes[/p][p]
-Added a track share code system. You can now click the share button and a track share code will be copied to your clipboard, this can then be pasted in the box in game to directly download a track.[/p]
